data.name: Barclay
data.long_meaning: A name derived from Old English 'bear' and 'clif' or Old Norse 'barkr' and 'leikr' meaning 'son of barley' or 'stony clearing'. In the Bible, Barclay could refer to Barclay the son of Abaddon mentioned in the book of Numbers. The name also has connections to St. Bartholomew, one of the twelve apostles.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of nourishment and sustenance, representing the bounty and abundance of God's providence.
